subject.title: feat: migrate google merchant feeds to bigquery source

question: Should the first implementation keep Google Merchant generation in GitHub Actions and migrate used feeds to BigQuery first, or move the whole pipeline into `apps/data-platform` now?
rationale: Both paths are plausible, but the issue explicitly leaves deployment location and fallback strategy open, and the new-books feed has a known schema dependency that changes rollout order.

options.title: Phase in place first
options.body: Keep the existing GitHub Actions and SFTP flow, migrate used feeds to BigQuery, then add `newData.logista` materialization before new-books cutover.

options.title: Move to data-platform now
options.body: Relocate feed generation under `apps/data-platform` as part of the migration, accepting a larger first PR and deployment-surface change.

options.title: Keep Mongo fallback
options.body: Allow a temporary Mongo fallback for new books while BigQuery parity is proven, but document when it must be removed.

recommendation.title: Phase in place first
recommendation.body: Keep the existing GitHub Actions and SFTP flow, migrate used feeds to BigQuery, then add `newData.logista` materialization before new-books cutover.

likelyOwner.reason: JavierHamelyn already produced the viability analysis and two-phase recommendation on the issue.
